name: Kiosk Phone
description: Turns this kiosk into a SIP phone on your PBX. Calls ring on the screen, and pages and announcements play through Kiosk Satellite's own intercom. Optional: a doorbell camera's picture and up to 3 buttons (DTMF or a URL) on the call card.
author: Mike Janofsky

settings.title: PBX address
settings.description: Host name or IP of the PBX.

settings.title: Extension
settings.description: SIP user, one extension per kiosk.

settings.title: Auth user
settings.description: Leave empty to use the extension.

settings.title: Password
settings.description: SIP secret. Needs Kiosk Satellite 2026.10.22 or newer.

settings.title: Local SIP port
settings.description: UDP port this kiosk listens on. (number)

settings.title: Intercom key
settings.description: This kiosk's intercom key, as set in Kiosk Satellite.

settings.title: KS admin port
settings.description: Kiosk Satellite admin/identity port on this kiosk. (number)

settings.title: Microphone gain
settings.description: Boosts your voice on calls if the caller finds it quiet. 1 = off, up to 30. (number)

settings.title: Camera stream
settings.description: rtsp://user:password@host:554/path of an H.264 camera (for example go2rtc). Shown on the call card while it rings and during the call. Empty = off.

settings.title: Callers with video
settings.description: Comma-separated numbers or names, matched exactly (e.g. **620 or 620). A * at the end matches the start (0611*), *R20K* matches part of a name. Empty = every call.

settings.title: Callers with buttons
settings.description: Comma-separated numbers or names, matched exactly (e.g. **620 or 620). A * at the end matches the start (0611*), *R20K* matches part of a name. URL buttons are only shown when this is set. Empty = every call.

settings.title: Button 1
settings.description: Label | action, optionally | mdi:icon. Actions: dtmf:1 (RFC 2833 in the call), info:1 (SIP INFO), url:https://... (POST) or get:https://... (GET); http://user:password@host/... for devices with Basic or Digest login. DTMF works once the call is answered; a URL works while it rings too. Example: Open gate | dtmf:1 | mdi:gate-open. Needs Kiosk Satellite 2026.11.24 or newer.

settings.title: Button 2
settings.description: Same format as Button 1. Empty = no button.

settings.title: Button 3
settings.description: Same format as Button 1. Empty = no button.
